inspection: Read-only saved scene and existing C# scripts; Unity was not operated or modified.
units: metres; vectors x,y,z; front is negative Z

scope.avoid: Opaque geometry in front of either line within the clear aperture; fake exported waves; moving or scaling the existing LineRenderer objects.

old_knob.collider: Capsule, radius .5, height 2, local Y, transformed with old mesh

phase.integration_warning: The moving part is the old scaled Handle, not a unit-scale empty pivot. Either export a normalized approximately unit-sized grip mesh, or apply reciprocal child scale. Do not reset the old Handle scale because its BoxCollider depends on it.

gain.integration_warning: Same non-unit moving Handle scale constraint as PHASE.

lock_indicator.behavior: SignalScope toggles Lens_On MeshRenderer.enabled directly every LateUpdate. Power must be online and frequency/phase/gain must match for 3 seconds. Children do not inherit MeshRenderer.enabled; do not simply hide old Lens_On and expect a child new lens to follow it.
lock_indicator.recommended_integration: Retain existing Lens_On as the actual functional luminous surface. Add new static bezel/body and off-lens around/behind it. Keep a clear aperture at local center (0,.025) at least .124 x .054. Alternatively replacing the on lens requires user to remap lockLamp to the new MeshRenderer.

collider_policy: Keep old GameObjects and colliders enabled; hide old MeshRenderers only. Every old rectangular body/track/handle uses a unit BoxCollider centered zero, its physical size coming from Transform scale. Existing Frequency knob uses CapsuleCollider. New meshes should stay inside or close to these hit areas.
slider_behavior: MachineSlider Awake sets Handle.localPosition from initialValue. Q/R step is smoothed over .1 sec; LMB drag is continuous and immediate. Mesh must travel with existing Handle. Do not add a second stationary exported grip to the housing.
